title: Matr3 lowering induces a specific RBP liability program led by Atp9b, Ddhd1, E2f4, Zkscan3, and Rsrp1
exact_observed_result: Matr3 lowering induced a recurrent Atp9b/Ddhd1/E2f4/Zkscan3/Kcnq2/Sugp2/Uggt2-up and Rsrp1-down core across 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA; Fus and Tardbp were active comparators but did not reproduce that MATR3 core.
biological_interpretation: The result defines an acute MATR3-loss RNA-binding-protein liability program that is distinct from TDP-43 or FUS loss even though all three genes are tied to ALS/RBP biology.

source_findings.summary: Matr3 transcript reduction was directionally present in every measured class, but sizeable downstream DE was concentrated in thalamic and midbrain classes plus one L4-5 cortical IT class.
source_findings.why_it_matters: The response is not a uniform consequence of lowering a ubiquitous nuclear RNA-binding protein; the dataset identifies neuronal contexts in which acute Matr3 loss is transcriptionally amplified.
source_findings.cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA
source_findings.main_caveats: On-target Matr3 FDR<0.05 was detected in only 4 of 21 classes; several smaller classes have weaker engagement and cannot be interpreted as true resistance.

source_findings.summary: ALS-linked RNA-binding-protein perturbations did not recapitulate the Matr3 recurrent core, even when Tardbp or Fus perturbations produced broad signatures in the same cell type.
source_findings.why_it_matters: This separates the acute Matr3-loss state from a generic RBP-loss or ALS-RBP knockdown state and argues against treating Tardbp, Fus, Hnrnpa1, and Hnrnpa2b1 as interchangeable comparators in this dataset.
source_findings.cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
source_findings.main_caveats: The comparison uses transcriptome similarity after knockdown rather than biochemical interaction; guide efficiency and target engagement differ among perturbations.

source_findings.summary: Fus and Matr3 perturbations did not phenocopy Tardbp in the Tardbp-sensitive hindbrain/thalamic groups despite being functionally linked RNA-binding proteins; Fus is also an ALS-family comparator.
source_findings.why_it_matters: The map argues against treating related RNA-binding proteins as interchangeable perturbations; the Tardbp loss-of-function program is more specific than generic RBP knockdown or motor-neuron-disease-gene stress.
source_findings.cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
source_findings.main_caveats: The comparison is transcriptomic only and limited to the cell types in which the comparator perturbations had measurable engagement.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Matr3 was measured in 21 cell types and decreased in all 21; logFC range -0.987 to -0.286. Four cell types had Matr3 FDR<0.05: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut logFC -0.987 FDR 6.28e-16 with 130 perturbed cells, 155 MB Glut logFC -0.902 FDR 1.44e-08 with 94 cells, 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut logFC -0.890 FDR 5.60e-06 with 75 cells, and 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA logFC -0.828 FDR 0.0451 with 40 cells.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: On-target Matr3 transcript modulation after the Matr3 perturbation.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: FDR<0.05 gene counts after Matr3 perturbation: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut 149, 155 MB Glut 104, 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut 43, 191 MB P MY GABA 42, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA 25, 145 MH-LH TH Glut 18, 054 CNU-MGE GABA 13, 009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut 13; the remaining assayed classes had 0-9.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Cell-type skew in the number of significant downstream DE genes.

evidence_ledger_rows.cell_type: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut; 191 MB P MY GABA
evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: For the 10-gene recurrent Matr3 core, the Matr3 perturbation produced same-direction FDR<0.05 changes in 9/10 genes in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, 10/10 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 10/10 in 155 MB Glut, and 9/10 in 191 MB P MY GABA. In the same cell types, Fus produced 0 same-direction and 1 opposite-direction core changes; Tardbp produced 1 same-direction and 0-1 opposite-direction core changes; Hnrnpa1, Hnrnpa2b1, and Son produced 0 same-direction core changes.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: ALS-associated RNA-binding-protein perturbations did not reproduce the recurrent Matr3 gene module.

evidence_ledger_rows.cell_type: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut; 191 MB P MY GABA
evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Comparator DE burdens at FDR<0.05 showed that lack of core-module overlap was not simply inactivity: Tardbp had 210, 91, and 97 DE genes in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA; Fus had 130, 20, and 15; Hnrnpa2b1 had 11, 1, and 1.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Several RNA-binding-protein comparators generated significant signatures in Matr3-responsive classes.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Fus was strongly self-depleted in 151, 155, and 191, with Fus FDR 1.0e-45, 1.2e-25, and 3.9e-24, but its all-gene Pearson correlations to the corresponding Tardbp signatures were -0.014, 0.023, and -0.005 and top-200 correlations were -0.014, 0.042, and 0.012. Matr3 was self-depleted in 151 and 155 with FDR 6.3e-16 and 1.4e-08, but its all-gene correlations to Tardbp were -0.003 and 0.041.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: ALS-linked TDP-43-interacting RNA-binding-protein perturbations had been engaged in the dataset but did not recreate the Tardbp expression response.

caveats: The assay is gene-level and does not test alternative splicing, RNA export, or protein aggregation.
Comparator divergence can reflect acute knockdown context and guide efficiency rather than every ALS mechanism.
